description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling ResourcesModified events within the context of policy persistence. It extends an abstract event strategy and applies updates to a policy based on resource modification events.

classes.name: ResourcesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractPolicyEventStrategy specialized for ResourcesModified events, applying policy updates accordingly.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to process a ResourcesModified event, updating the associated policy with new resource information.
